title.zh-CN: 1.6.2 正式版 · 球槽反向调整

summary.zh-CN: 为底部球槽加入反向向下调整，可同步移动实际判定位置，预览与保存继续使用同一套素材位置规则
summary.en-US: Add downward receptor adjustment with optional hit-position linking, keeping preview and exported artwork aligned

zh-CN: 在球槽与判定位置中设置 0–180 的调整幅度，默认向上，勾选反向调整（向下移动）后向下移动
勾选联动实际判定位置时，向下移动同步增大 HitPosition，保持 240–480 范围；关闭联动时只移动图像
向下保存通过裁短按键图片底部实现，移出画面底部的图像会被裁切，图片裁空或判定位置超出范围时拒绝保存
预览在按键图像翻转前裁切，保持松开与按下图像、SD / @2x 和保存结果的位置关系
en-US: Set an adjustment amount from 0 to 180 in Receptors and hit position; the default moves up, while Reverse direction (move down) moves down
With hit-position linking enabled, downward movement increases HitPosition within 240–480; disabling linking moves only the artwork
Export downward movement by shortening the bottom of key images, clipping artwork beyond the playfield edge; reject empty images and out-of-range hit positions
Crop preview key images before flipping so idle and pressed artwork, SD / @2x rounding and export positioning remain aligned

zh-CN: 保存皮肤副本后再选用或导出 OSK，原皮肤不变，载入副本时清空本次虚拟调整，避免重复叠加
保留图片兼容性修复、Mania 试玩、Standard 自动测试与简洁双通道更新，正式版构建号升为 12
离线仅保留当前版本说明，在线历史保留此前正式版与 Beta 记录
en-US: Select the exported skin copy or package it as an OSK without modifying the original; loading the copy resets the virtual adjustment to avoid applying it twice
Retain image compatibility repair, Mania playtesting, Standard auto tests and compact dual-channel updates with stable build number 12
Bundle only the current release note offline while retaining earlier stable and Beta announcements online
